text:
emily (Demand Gen): Quick sync — we need final on the Nebula marketplace onboarding + syndicated benchmark webinar flow. timeline?
ryan (Partnerships): Partner wants marketplace listing live the same week as the benchmark blog + webinar. They offered their internal dataset for the benchmark if we can co-author.
arjun (Content): Good opportunity. We'll need a short methodology section, reproducible commands, and a guest quote. I can draft the benchmark post and the webinar abstract.
emma (Marketing Ops): Routing note: prereg form should capture: company, email, role, cloud preference, interest: hosted/dedicated/private. We'll use `utm_source=nebula_marketplace` and a hidden `partner=nebula` field.
nate (AdOps): For paid promo: want 2 creatives — one for marketplace launch, one for benchmark results. Recommend $1k start in NA + $500 EMEA. Also can run retargeting for blog visitors who don't convert.
emily (Demand Gen): Webinar format: 30 min + 15 Q&A. Speakers: Nebula eng, Redwood infra lead, and one customer (TBD). Run-of-show: 5' intro, 10' benchmark highlights, 10' demo of integration, 5' roadmap + CTA.
ryan (Partnerships): Customer willing to join panel if we share talking points. Need partner social assets and logo SVG for listing. Legal asked for an asset use form — they'll return by EOD.
arjun (Content): For the benchmark methodology, let's include commands and a small repo with scripts. Will call out quant settings, sequence lengths, and batching config. Want to avoid proprietary configs from partner — we can redact internal ids.
emma (Marketing Ops): Lead routing rules draft: if `partner=nebula` and role in ["Engineer","SRE","Dev"] -> assign to Product SDR queue; if role in ["CTO","Head of AI","Director"] -> create SFDC lead + assign to AE queue. If "private" checkbox checked -> tag as enterprise and notify #eng-sre.
nate (AdOps): Add experiment param `exp=cta_v1` vs `exp=cta_v2` on CTA links so we can test copy. Also please add `creative_id` to the final URLs so we can attribute spend.
emily (Demand Gen): Promotion cadence: 2 weeks pre - marketplace blog + teaser, 1 week pre - webinar invite, 3 days - reminder, day-of - final reminder + live tweet. Post - recording + benchmark deep-dive blog.
ryan (Partnerships): Can Nebula host the joint webinar registration page on their site? We prefer single signup to avoid duplicate leads. If yes, ask them to pass leads to our webhook with the hidden `partner` param.
emma (Marketing Ops): We can accept partner-hosted form if they POST to our endpoint. Need sample payload and a shared secret. I'll send the webhook spec.
arjun (Content): Content timeline: draft by Fri, internal review Mon, partner review Tue, publish Wed, webinar Thu. Tight but doable if partner legal is fast.
ops-bot: Webhook endpoint `https://hooks.redwood.ai/marketing/partner-reg` created. Shared secret pending.
emma (Marketing Ops): Also will create HubSpot list `nebula_marketplace_prereg` and workflows to tag and route. Will add daily digest to #sales for new high-intent preregs.
ryan (Partnerships): One ask from partner: include a short co-branded one-pager (PDF) we can attach to the webinar follow-up. Arjun can you produce a 1-pager with highlights + benchmark graph?
arjun (Content): Yep — will make a 1-pager and provide an editable Figma file.
nate (AdOps): Creative checklist: 1200x627 social, 1080x1080 for partner channels, 300x250 for DSP. I'll upload to the campaign folder.
emma (Marketing Ops): Small ops detail: please avoid `utm_campaign=nebula_launch_v2` — use stable `nebula_launch_2026` so we don't split attribution with previous tests.
emily (Demand Gen): Final question: embargo? Partner wants social embargo lifted Thu 9am PT (day of webinar). Do we agree?
ryan (Partnerships): Yes, partner legal requested that. We can keep blog live earlier but hold social until Thu 9am PT.
emae (Demand Gen): (typo) meant emily: noted.
arjun (Content): I'll set the blog to publish Wed 6am PT and schedule social for Thu 9am PT.
emma (Marketing Ops): Action items: I'll send webhook spec & secret, create HubSpot lists, add routing workflows.
nate (AdOps): I'll upload creatives + set up retargeting pixel.
ryan (Partnerships): I'll confirm partner asset delivery timeline and the customer panelist.
emily (Demand Gen): Arjun will finish drafts and assemble speaker bios. Meeting: quick check tomorrow 10am PT. Thanks everyone. :tada:
